The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 24/10/2011, the use of the building at Unit 9 Syon Gate Way, Brentford, Middlesex, TW8 9DD, for storage and distribution, was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for the following reason:
The application in respect of the use of the unit at Unit 9 Syon Gate Way, Brentford, Middlesex, TW8 9DD, for storage and distribution, would be contrary to Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act (as amended) and the use would not be lawful. The evidence supplied fails to establish that on the balance of probabilities that the building has been used for storage and distribution for an uninterrupted period of at least ten years.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness of existing use of the building for Storage and Distribution purposes (Use Class B8).
